summary: Yannick Lapointe, pre-qualified for Day 2 of the 2000 Decipher World Championship, went 6–2 with Bring Him Before Me ("The MACHINE") and Mind What You Have Learned ("The MACHINE KILLA") and finished 4th to reach Day 3.
notes: Report covers Day 2 only (Day 1 only as a spectator, plus casual games with an EBO deck); Lapointe went on to finish 2nd overall (separate Day 3 report d1324). author_finish is the Day 2 place he states ("finish 6-2 in 4 place"), matching the hub's Day 2 4th 12 (75).
Known margins sum to +71; the hub's +75 implies games 5 and 6 vs Asselin netted about +4.
Lapointe played Asselin in consecutive games 5 and 6 (each side) and Brian Rippetoe twice (games 4 and 7), as stated.

Deck pages: The MACHINE KILLA page says "the deck i use at day 2 going 4-0" (Light went 4–0 here) → linked. THE MACHINE (Dark BHBM, posted 10 October 2000, same day as this report) doesn't name the day; hub groups it with Day 3 posts, but no revised Dark was posted, so it is linked as the Day 2 Dark. Bill may want to unlink if strict.
Carman's "fake hb" not linked to the Hidden Base objective (could mean a non-Hidden Base deck); Rippetoe's Ice Plains/Defensive Perimeter and Throne Room mains decks have no Objective.
Opponent ratings in parentheses in the report are kept in game notes.

Martin Paquette (DQ at 4–0 for writing 1 AFA instead of 4) and "Joe" (2–2, dropped) are Lapointe's Quebec friends; Paquette has no page yet (full name → new page per brief). Dominic = Dominic Gaudreault, Raphael = Raphael Asselin (context: Quebec crew, top 12).
Event site: report says only "Orlando"; hub has Kissimmee (same area), not a discrepancy.
Body contains slurs and abuse aimed at a Denny's waitress (published verbatim per brief); title is clean so withhold_title false.
